title: Parse a line item, reusing the package's money parsing
task: Add `ParseLineItem(text string) (LineItem, error)` to package `billing`. A line item looks like `Blue Widget x3 @ 12.50`: a description, a quantity after `x`, and a unit price after `@`, and `LineItem` should expose the description, the quantity, and the line total in cents. Reuse what the package already has for money rather than writing it again. Test a normal line, a quantity of zero, and a malformed price.
